name: How do I choose a smoke odor removal company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a smoke odor removal company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a smoke odor removal company, look for experience, certifications, and comprehensive services. Ensure they are IICRC-certified (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification) for smoke and fire damage. Ask about their specific processes, equipment used, and whether they offer a guarantee for odor removal. Check customer reviews and ask for references. It's also beneficial to choose a local company that can respond quickly in an emergency and understands the nuances of properties in your area. transparent pricing and clear communication are also key indicators of a reliable provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company based on experience, IICRC certification, comprehensive services, and a guarantee for odor removal. Check reviews, ask for references, and prioritize transparent local providers.
